independentReview.body:
**Independent re-review: ACCEPT the bounded #69 controller correction. My private-engagement blocker in [6202205906](https://github.com/tannerthardy/football-simulation-/pull/69#issuecomment-6202205906) is resolved; no remaining blocker in this reviewed scope.**

Reviewed controller/test **`cdd55b955421744ae6ba688de5f73ab87d13b8ab`**, evidence/head **`084122c16264962801fab963bcc35023d3104a64`**, runtime source **`cf8d726d81b1d562fd4c2a959f3bff3ed9c3b0f60fcf2587481386db9394e08a`**. This is a controller disposition, not merge or physics-promotion authority.

**Production hook:** [blocking.ts:1110](https://github.com/tannerthardy/football-simulation-/blob/cdd55b955421744ae6ba688de5f73ab87d13b8ab/src/sim/behaviors/blocking.ts#L1110) removes the remote `target.engagement` gate. Installed original-check responsibility, acquired owner torso-loss/clearance, ordinary read cadence and the helper's own joint/contact eligibility remain. Changing the defender's private flag can no longer clear this held collection read merely through that gate. Ordinary physical `sim.engage` eligibility at1098–1102 remains separate and unchanged; this correction awards no hands.

**Regression:** [collection-approach.test.ts:69](https://github.com/tannerthardy/football-simulation-/blob/cdd55b955421744ae6ba688de5f73ab87d13b8ab/test/collection-approach.test.ts#L69) calls public `RunBlocker.update` and uses a call-through spy on the original attack method. It covers both held-read identity and fresh selection with the private flag nonempty, while acquired pictures, own body and RNG stay fixed. The old source's expected failure changes a held brake into `(6.987817,-2.997026)`yd/s. Corrected choices stay equal; a newly delivered facing cue can still change the next ordinary read. The detached former-rep flag is an appropriate no-step information poison, not a claimed physically reacting continuation.

**Compatible evidence reused, no duplicate campaign:** I independently verified all13 published artifact hashes and that the complete extraction equals the exact four-file diff. Offline comparison confirms all10 saved center/isolated-law cases retain exact bodies, requests, reports and events; native Under/Tite fingerprints and observer-neutral controls match. Collection geometry and the force/reach/torso/support/installed-side assertions are unchanged. Both isolated-law mirrors still acquire2.55/load2.60, retain usable upright contact through3.40 and remove25 former-owner impacts each. The genuinely obstructed C/RT control still executes finite braking over eight real World steps without impacts, manufactured hands or climb. Reuse the compatible64 focused passes/typecheck on cdd55b9; I ran zero tests and zero World steps for this review.

**Limits retained:** collection witnesses park the runner. Their collected surface is demonstrated; live runner-arrival protection, yardage benefit, complete motion guarantees and global RunBlocker information correctness remain unproved. The three adjudicated #66-host failures, rejected variants, history/yaw/physics accuracy holds remain visible. This review does not reopen broader assignment/join/release consumers.

**Integration:** current fetched accepted develop remains `8ca8deebe4afa91c3021bdd119bed8976cf00e47`, reconciled with #74's acceptance update6202634529. The supplied complete four-file extraction preserves #72 PassProtector and #74 carrier risk; its static application is not combined runtime verification. Integration owns the exact final composition/checks and subsequent adoption decision. Do not import the separate #66 context ancestry. Author repair evidence cost18.244548s, including expected-red; original47.417s evidence remains separately pinned.

**#76 remains unchanged:** branch/head `codex/rb-local-traffic@4cf253efead2cac450abe0bc74aa5e0db0306126`, code2e1dfa3. No jukes, stepping-over, width change, navigation tuning, source edit or new campaign was added during this review.
